decisions.reason: As a 2023-launched range extension still given its own page in 2024, it reflects visible commitment with relatively low ongoing risk, so management is likely to continue backing it rather than reverse course quickly.
This product has remained prominently presented since its 2023 launch and fits the firm's core drainage offering, making continued support likely under escalation of commitment.
Although the earlier pump-assisted variant disappeared, this 2024 launch represents a fresh and public recommitment to the concept, so management would likely give it more time before withdrawing it.
